description: Create a selected PrivateDAO capability request and return either an immediate result or an exact quote-first payment intent. Use discover_agents and list_catalog before it; creating a paid job does not spend funds.

payment_mode.description: Select privatepay only when the PrivatePAY x402 status is enabled.

pdao_access.description: Optional signed PDAO holder challenge from /api/access/challenge.

name: create_paid_job

outputSchema.description: Quote-first service request result; creating the request does not spend funds.

payment_intent.description: Exact quote and recipient details when payment is required.

receipt.description: Public receipt metadata when the request completes.

result.description: Service result when the request completes immediately.

status.description: Request status, commonly awaiting_payment or completed.

title: PrivateDAO Service Request
